title: Bubbles of Psyche
description: A surreal painting featuring a large central female face with vibrant red flowing hair and green patterned skin, enclosed within a translucent pink bubble. Smaller bubbles containing similar stylized faces float around her against a dark green cosmic background filled with abstract organic shapes and glowing particles.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a woman with elaborate flowing red hair and green patterned skin, her face emerging from a giant translucent pink bubble containing a colorful flower-like pattern. Multiple smaller bubbles with miniature versions of her face float around her in a dark emerald green cosmic space filled with abstract organic forms and glowing particles, vibrant colors, intricate linework.
